name: FarmOS v4
tagline: A web-based farm record keeping application.
description: farmOS is a web-based application for farm management, planning, and record keeping. It is developed by a community of volunteers and aims to provide a standard platform for farmers, developers, and researchers to build upon.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Mysql root password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-farmos-v4 application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-farmos-v4
  # The `big-bear-farmos-v4` service definition
  big-bear-farmos-v4:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-farmos-v4
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: farmos/farmos:4.0.9@sha256:3df7871c0bdbd994d084fe58448e15e63094128d74621f76e19198ff8bce3f69
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      # Mounting the sites directory
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/sites:/opt/drupal/web/sites
    # Ports mapping between host and container
    ports:
      # Mapping port 8083 of the host to port 80 of the container (8080=v3, 8081=vikunja, 8082=vikunja-v2)
      - "${APP_PORT}:80"
    depends_on:
      - big-bear-farmos-v4-db
    networks:
      - big-bear-farmos-v4-network
  # MariaDB database service configuration for FarmOS v4
  big-bear-farmos-v4-db:
    # Specify the container name
    container_name: big-bear-farmos-v4-db
    # Use MariaDB 10.6 image (minimum required for farmOS v4)
    image: mariadb:10.6@sha256:114d40be36852d0a019afd8458f7e1cc63fd300403b115b1f32e31130d5f671b
    # Mount the database files to persist data
    volumes:
      - "${APP_DATA_DIR}/db:/var/lib/mysql"
    # Expose MariaDB port to host (different from v3's 3306)
    ports:
      - "3307:3306"
    # Database environment configuration
    environment:
      # Root user password
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}
      # Name of the database to create
      MYSQL_DATABASE: big_bear_farmos
      # Create a database user
      MYSQL_USER: farmos
      # Set the database user password
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}
    # Health check configuration to ensure database is running properly
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "healthcheck.sh", "--connect", "--innodb_initialized"]
      start_period: 1m
      start_interval: 10s
      interval: 1m
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
    # Connect to the FarmOS v4 network
    networks:
      - big-bear-farmos-v4-network
networks:
  big-bear-farmos-v4-network:
    name: big-bear-farmos-v4-network
    driver: bridge
